kk_reduction.isometry: DERIVED: Killing vectors of a flat metric on R^8/Gamma are the 8 constant translations -> continuous isometry U(1)^8; KK reduction of pure gravity gives 8 abelian graviphotons g_{mu i} (+ 36 metric moduli). Rotations are not isometries; only the finite point group Aut(E8)=W(E8), order 696,729,600, survives as a DISCRETE global symmetry. No non-abelian gauge group.
kk_reduction.root_states_point_particle: the 240 states with momentum k = root (|k|^2=2) are the first KK shell: massive spin-2 (graviton KK) states carrying U(1)^8 charges; mass M = sqrt2/R at equal volume, never massless
kk_reduction.string_enhancement: closed string on T^8 with lattice Gamma_8 at the self-dual point (G_ij = C_ij/2, B_ij = antisymmetrised Cartan matrix, alpha'=1; Elitzur-Gross-Rabinovici-Seiberg 1987, from memory): winding+momentum states with p_R=0, p_L^2=2 are massless -> E8 gauge bosons. Near the point, along an overall scale t: M_root ~ (sqrt2/sqrt(alpha')) |t - 1/t| (circle-analog, ASSUMED form). Requires R ~ sqrt(alpha') ~ 1/M_string, i.e. R^-1 ~ M_s ~ TeV-Planck, NOT the ADD radius R^-1 ~ GeV.
kk_reduction.heterotic: heterotic E8xE8: the E8xE8 roots live in the 16-dimensional INTERNAL left-moving lattice Gamma_8+Gamma_8, massless at any radius; that lattice is not a geometric spacetime torus. Dan's geometric E8 torus is a different object.

chirality.flat_torus: DERIVED (index theorem): Dirac index on flat T^n vanishes -> zero net chiral zero modes; KK reduction on R^8/Gamma_8 gives a NON-CHIRAL 4D spectrum (Witten 1983 no-go for smooth/flat). Lattice shape (E8 vs Z8) is irrelevant.
chirality.fixes: chirality needs orbifold fixed points, singularities, fluxes or a domain wall (Stage 5 kink, Q=1)
chirality.heterotic_Z3: heterotic E8xE8 on T^6/Z3, standard embedding: E6xSU(3)xE8, net 36 generations of 27 = 9 untwisted [(27,3): 3 x 3] + 27 twisted (one per fixed point) (Dixon-Harvey-Vafa-Witten 1985; from memory)
chirality.calabi_yau: standard embedding on CY3: N_gen = |chi|/2; three generations need |chi| = 6 (e.g. Tian-Yau/Z3) (from memory)
chirality.three_flag: COINCIDENCE/FEATURE: the "3" of E8 > E6 x SU(3) is the SU(3) holonomy of a 6-dim compact space, not the generation number; it multiplies untwisted 27s (giving 9 on T^6/Z3), and N_gen is set by topology (chi or fixed points). Not a prediction of 3.
chirality.lisi: Distler & Garibaldi, Commun. Math. Phys. 298, 419 (2010), arXiv:0905.2658 (verified): no subgroup SL(2,C).G of any real or complex form of E8 gives a chiral gauge theory; 3 generations need >= 180 states in the fermionic (-1) eigenspace, real E8 forms provide only 112 or 128.
chirality.dims_note: heterotic uses 6 compact dims (10D string); Dan's 8 compact dims (12D total) has no known consistent string/M-theory with an E8-torus; E8 here is a lattice, not a gauge group.

couplings.formula: 1/g4^2 = V8/g_D^2, g_D^2 = gD2_hat / M_D^8 (dimensionless bulk coupling ASSUMED O(1)-4pi)
couplings.verdict: bulk gauge fields give alpha_4 ~ 1e-37: excluded by ~35 orders unless g_D is non-perturbatively huge (gD2_hat ~ 1e33: tuning). Bulk SM gauge fields would also have KK copies at ~2-4 GeV, excluded (UED-type limits >~ TeV, from memory). => SM gauge fields must be brane-confined; then the bulk lattice does not set the gauge group.

kk_spectrum.observability: each KK graviton couples as 1/Mbar (2.4e18 GeV): individual shells unresolvable; summed monojet/diphoton rates are shape-independent up to (M1/E)^2 ~ 4e-6 at 1 TeV (Weyl law). Gravity deviation at r~lambda=1e-16 m unmeasurable (Stage 7). n=8 collider bound UNVERIFIED (CMS covers n<=7).
